title: What Mind-State Archiving Is
definition: Mind-State Archiving: preserving detailed maps of individual minds.
description:
Strip Mind-State Archiving to its essence and you get preserving detailed maps of individual minds. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Medicine & Longevity: first scan vaults understanding, then archive logistics prototypes, then neural mapping operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

title: Readiness Estimator: Mind-State Archiving
definition: Estimates Mind-State Archiving readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mind-State Archiving components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a archive hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mind-State Archiving Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mind-State Archiving: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mind-State Archiving — preserving detailed maps of individual minds.

Phase 1 — Prove (scan vaults): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (archive logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (neural mapping): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (consent frameworks): archive hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and neurotechnology-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
